sectionDescription: Transparent, structured, outcome-driven. Here's exactly what happens when we work together.

steps.title: Discovery Call
steps.description: We start with a free 15-minute call. I learn about your background, target role, and timeline. No pressure - just clarity on whether we're a fit.

steps.title: Gap Assessment
steps.description: In our first session, I evaluate where you stand against FAANG interview rubrics. We identify the 2-3 areas that will make the biggest impact.

steps.title: Personalized Roadmap
steps.description: You get a clear action plan: what we'll cover, in what order, with specific milestones. No generic prep - everything is tailored to your target role.

steps.title: Live Coaching Sessions
steps.description: We meet via Google Meet with real-time whiteboarding. Mock interviews, story crafting, system design - all recorded for your review.

steps.title: Ongoing Support
steps.description: Between sessions, you have WhatsApp access for quick questions. I review your materials and provide async feedback when needed.

transparency.title: Full Transparency
points: Session recordings are yours to keep
No lock-in - book as you go
Refund if not satisfied after first session

cta.text: Start with a Free Discovery Call
